rationale:
bugs_open/405, candidate 1 - the door-closing fix, owner-directed lineage ('find the thread that produced that promoter or file a new bug for it'; both producing lanes are CLOSED, so the fix lands with write_audit_findings' owner, which is this lane per RFC_056).

THE DEFECT, twice peer-verified (the 391 lane re-verified §1 verbatim against the live pre_query and re-derived the counts): detected-item-promoter's four doors interrogate the HANDLER and the (item_type, handler) pair's lifetime history; none asks what PRODUCED the row. So an LLM auditor's OPINION filed at 'detected' rides a known-good door whose completions were earned by mechanical defects: [MEASURED 2026-08-25] 27 opinion rows promoted 08-20..24 while improvement-sweep was DISABLED - rewrites the owner believed were off. The axis cannot be DERIVED from the row ([MEASURED, 391 lane] created_by = a drifting seat-name list; source='discovery' spans 6,763 rows across 27 creators; spec ? 'audit_source' over-blocks tool-acceptance-tier4 and owner-request) - so the stamp must be WRITTEN by the producer and READ by the door.

THE FIX, two halves, one literal, lockstep-pinned: (Go) classifyFinding's base spec gains origin='model_opinion' unconditionally - every classification arm carries it (pinned per-arm by TestOriginStamp_EveryClassificationArmCarriesIt, including the capability_gap fallback), record mode preserves it (TestOriginStamp_SurvivesRecordMode), and every live caller of the action is a model seat (6 write steps, census in RFC_056 addendum 2 §8 settled on three instruments incl. jsonb_path recursive descent), so a future mechanical adopter would widen the HOLD - the safe direction. (SQL) migration 629 installs the fifth door by four verbatim-anchored replaces on the live pre_query (the 616 pattern: each anchor asserted EXACTLY ONCE first, so any drift stops the migration): origin_ok in scored, required by candidates, included in held's complement, NAMED in held's reason CASE ('model opinion - release by hand or via record mode'). TestOriginDoorLockstep reads the migration file and builds the needle FROM the Go constant, requiring it at exactly the two sites that must agree (the edit and its verify) - the Go<->SQL drift 405 §7 names as where a split-ownership fix would break.

SEQUENCING (no ordering constraint claimed, 2026-07-29 ruling): the door holds only stamped rows; the stamp rides the next chassis roll (written after v1.0.1339). Either order is safe - the door is inert until stamped rows exist; unstamped rows (every mechanical discovery finding, incl. the design rotation re-enabled 09:20Z today) pass untouched. Rehearsed apply and apply-then-rollback in rolled-back transactions; live pre_query untouched (origin_ok count 0). Verification after the roll is 405 §6's REFINED two-direction form: the held direction uses one synthetic stamped row (closed by hand afterwards); the ticks-ran direction uses a NATURAL promotion, never a synthetic control - a synthetic promotable row would be dispatched to a real handler.

RELATION TO RECORD MODE (RFC_056, approved r2): adjacent, not substitutes. Record mode changes what the six seats FILE (deferred verdicts); this door changes what the promoter ADMITS, whoever filed it - it covers the residues record mode cannot: a hand-fired seat without record mode, and any future opinion-shaped producer at 'detected'.

plan.risks: 1) EXPECTED OBJECTION - 'stamp only when the seat ran execute_llm_prompt, not unconditionally.' Answer: the action's own header says it routes LLM audit output; all six live callers are model seats; and the failure direction of over-stamping is a HOLD a person releases, while under-stamping re-opens 405. If a genuinely mechanical producer adopts the action later, the right fix is a declared origin value for it, not a conditional today. 2) The door reads spec->>'origin' on every promoter tick (96/day) - a per-row jsonb ->> in a CTE already doing three EXISTS subqueries per row; cost is negligible by comparison. 3) Historical rows are unstamped and pass the door for ever. Deliberate: retro-stamping 30k+ archive-joined rows is a bulk write with no consumer, and the acute inflow is already contained by 623/624; the door is for FUTURE producers (405 residues A/B). 4) The lockstep test reads a repo FILE while the live pre_query is DB state - repo-vs-live drift after apply is the standing migration-vs-live residual (RFC_006 class); the probe refuses re-apply and the ROLLBACK refuses non-verbatim text, which is the honest boundary without a daily checker. 5) The held CASE arm sits before known_good, so an opinion row with an unproven pair is labelled 'model opinion' rather than 'never completed' - reason precedence chosen so the held_detail names the DESIGNED hold first; a reviewer preferring the other order should say so, it is one line.
